response.justification: Bogdan has over 15 years of software development experience with a strong technical background in developer tools, testing infrastructure, and mobile platforms, making him an excellent domain fit for the Engineering Productivity team. However, the resume positions him strictly as an Individual Contributor (Senior/Staff Engineer) and lacks evidence of formal people management, such as conducting one-on-ones, managing team performance, or leading organizational change. While his technical expertise and mentorship are commendable, he falls short of the minimum requirement for 2 years of dedicated people management needed for this Level II Manager role.
strengths: Extensive experience building developer tools, testing infrastructure, and CI/CD pipelines (Altom Consulting, National Instruments, open-source test runners).
Strong domain knowledge in mobile platforms, having developed and maintained iOS and Apple TV applications.
Demonstrated technical leadership and mentorship through organizing coding dojos, testing workshops, and holding Staff-level engineering titles.
concerns: Lacks explicit formal people management experience, such as conducting one-on-ones, performance reviews, or managing direct reports.
No demonstrated experience leading organizational change or managing broad team priorities in a mid-to-senior management capacity.
Recent roles have been heavily focused on full-stack product development and individual contribution rather than dedicated engineering productivity management.
